title: Unearthing Financial Statement Fraud: Insights from News Coverage Analysis
eligible_reason: No DiD or event study. The package is a machine-learning fraud-detection pipeline (news scraping, FSFP measure construction, doc2vec business-similarity peer identification, meta-learning over 19 classifiers in detection_model.py, economic-value calculations). The only 'regressions' are sklearn LogisticRegression classifiers. No treatment timing or panel FE regression. The ft_difference_in_differences flag presumably reflects an incidental mention.
design_notes: Chinese listed firms; CSMAR/Datago inputs (not shipped); Python 3.9 scripts.
data_files: data/firm_num.csv, FSFP_threshold.csv, audit_fee_indus.csv, eval_chg.xlsx (small auxiliary files)
data/CSMAR_data and data/Datago_data folders empty (licensed); news data not included for legal reasons
screener_notes: Screened from package only (readme.md, grep of all .py files).
